requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "New hire onboarding guide"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Welcome to MoaLogis."}, {"id": 2, "text": "This document walks you through what to do step by step during your first two weeks ▶"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "For questions, please contact Joonho Byun (Joonho Byun), HR Manager."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Seojin Um (Seojin Um) will help you with setting up your development environment."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Day 1"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "When you arrive, first collect your access badge at the front desk on the first floor."}]}

replaced.text: 자리는 Dawn Team 옆이고, 엄서진 님도 같은 줄에 앉습니다.

requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The access badge you receive will be registered by Manager Byeon Jun-ho."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Your seat is next to the Dawn Team, and Eom Seo-jin also sits in the same row."}, {"id": 2, "text": "You eat lunch together with your teammates."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Day two"}, {"id": 1, "text": "On day two you spend the whole day on site."}, {"id": 2, "text": "For unloading work, you observe while wearing safety shoes."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "We don't speak to drivers who are working first."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The trial report goes up to the team lead for approval."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Once you've reviewed it, it will be passed on to Manager Byeon Jun-ho."}, {"id": 2, "text": "First week"}]}

replaced.text: MoaLogis 신규 입사자는 첫 주에 '발판'(Launchpad)이라는 과제 목록을 진행합니다.

requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "New MoaLogis hires work through a task list called \"Launchpad\" in their first week."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Launchpad item 1 is logging into the wiki and signing up for the internal messenger."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Company-wide announcements and casual chat happen in the \"Hearth\" channel."}]}

replaced.text: 발판 2번은 fleet allocation 시스템 Pathfinder 교육을 듣는 것입니다.
Pathfinder로 하루치 fleet allocation 계획을 직접 짜 봅니다.

requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Foothold 2 is taking the Pathfinder training on the fleet allocation system."}, {"id": 1, "text": "You will build a full day's fleet allocation plan yourself in Pathfinder."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Do not post practice screens in Hearth."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "You don't have to write long reports."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Once you finish the scaffolding, you'll start on real work in the second week."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Your first real task is to get a code review together with Mr./Ms. Eom-seojin."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Code review results are shared in the 모닥불 team channel."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "If you have any questions, feel free to ask Manager Byeon Jun-ho at any time."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Finally, just leave a one-line impression on Modakbul and you're all set."}]}
